OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer

## Summary

I implemented required-field validation for `POST /api/owners` following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions.

The problem: `BuildOwner` bound `@Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto`, so a missing/blank field triggered bean validation → `MethodArgumentNotValidException` → the existing handler's `ProblemDetail` body (which has `schemaValidationErrors`, **not** an `errors` array). To emit the promised `errors` field-name array, the check had to run *before* any `@Valid` binding.

Changes:

- **`RequireOwnerFields`** (new first step) — binds `@RequestBody` (the pipeline's single body binding), manually checks `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, `telephone` for null-or-blank, collecting each offending field name. If any are bad it throws the checked `RequiredFieldsException`; otherwise it publishes the DTO as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>`.
- **`BuildOwner`** — now reads the validated body via `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` instead of re-binding `@RequestBody` (only one step may bind the body).
- **`RequiredFieldsException`** — checked exception carrying the field-name list.
- **`RequiredFieldsExceptionHandler`** + escalation YAML — responds `400` with `ValidationErrorsResponse`, serialising as `{"errors": [...]}`.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — added the `validate` step ahead of `build`.

All 3 acceptance tests pass: missing `city` → 400 with `errors` containing `"city"`, blank telephone → 400, and a complete owner → 2xx.
